question: The sum of five numbers is 655. The average of the first two numbers is 80 and the third number is 108. Find the average of the remaining two numbers.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Total Sum** of 5 numbers = 655

**Sum** of first two numbers = 80 × 2 = 160

**Third number** = 108

**Sum** of remaining two numbers = 655 − (160 + 108) = 387

**Average** of remaining two = 387 ÷ 2 = 193.5

**∴ The correct answer is 193.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total numbers = 5

Sum of 5 numbers = 655

Average of first 2 numbers = 80

Third number = 108

**Formula Used:**

Sum = Average × Total numbers

Average = Sum ÷ Total numbers

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47609523eb1fc990642626463571ec9222f4e328ef0b8a96d58de72cfbfb85ea.png] 

⇒ Sum of the first two numbers = 80 × 2 = 160

⇒ Sum of the first three numbers = 160 + 108 = 268

⇒ Sum of the remaining two numbers = 655 − 268

⇒ Sum of the remaining two numbers = 387

⇒ Average of the remaining two numbers = 387 ÷ 2

⇒ Average = 193.5

**∴ The correct answer is 193.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Average Formula

The arithmetic mean or **average** is the ratio of the **sum of all observations** to the **total number** of observations.

Weighted Average

If there are groups with averages A₁, A₂,... and sizes n₁, n₂,..., the **combined average** is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂ + ...) ÷ (n₁ + n₂ + ...).

Net Deviation

The **sum of deviations** of all observations from their **arithmetic mean** is always equal to zero.</p
